explanation: This tests surface area using the cross product of tangent vectors to a parametrized surface, absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics, so it is prerequisite. Parametrize by r(z,θ)=⟨(1+z⁴)cos(θ),(1+z⁴)sin(θ),z⟩. The cross-product magnitude is (1+z⁴)√(1+(4z³)²)=(1+z⁴)√(1+16z⁶). Integrating θ over [0,2π] gives option e.
